name: animated-lucide-icons

frames.best_why: The whole icon grid is clean and evenly lit, with no cursor covering any tile.

tagline: A grid of outline icons that wiggle, ring and beat when you hover them.
summary: Twenty outline icon buttons, each labelled, that play a small hand-tuned animation on hover: a bell rings, a heart beats, a gear turns. The wrapper can fire the same animation from any parent element.
appearance: A five-by-four grid of rounded dark tiles on black, each holding a thin white outline icon with a tiny grey lowercase name beneath it. One tile at a time lightens under the pointer.
behaviour: Hovering a tile lightens its background and sets its icon moving: the bell swings, the heart pulses, the gear turns, the arrow shifts. The icon returns to rest when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: A grid of twenty named icons including bell, heart, gear, search, send and trash.
search_phrases: small icon motions for ui buttons
animated line icons for a menu
use_when: A toolbar or menu needs icon buttons that feel alive, with a small motion confirming each hover or tap.
avoid_when: Each icon is its own file and only a fixed set ships, and the motions are decorative in a dense toolbar.
customise: AnimateIcon wraps any child and takes triggers, an animation name, loop, delay and speed props; each icon ships preset variants. New motion or icons need a source edit.
weight_why: SVG paths animate only while hovered; twenty idle icons cost almost nothing.

a11y.note: Buttons are labelled and honour reduced motion, but the icon animation fires on pointer hover only, so keyboard focus never triggers it.

issues: Several icons animate so slightly that the stills look static.
The tiny grey labels are low contrast on the dark tiles.
polish_why: Neat, consistent icon grid; the tiles and tiny labels are plain and the motion is barely visible.
